item.content:encoded:
Surgical Procedures

This section documents surgical interventions and operative reports.

Procedure Types

Diagnostic Procedures

  • Colonoscopy — Screening and diagnostic
  • Upper endoscopy — GI evaluation
  • Biopsy — Tissue sampling procedures

Interventional Procedures

  • Central Venous Catheter/Port Placement — For chemotherapy administration
  • Imaging-guided biopsies — CT or ultrasound-guided tissue sampling

Therapeutic Surgeries

  • Resection procedures — Tumor or organ removal if indicated
  • Palliative procedures — Symptom management

Operative Report Components

Each operative report includes:

  • Pre-operative diagnosis — Why surgery was performed
  • Post-operative diagnosis — What was found
  • Procedure — What was done
  • Findings — Intraoperative observations
  • Technique — How the procedure was performed
  • Complications — Any adverse events
  • Disposition — Where patient went after surgery
  • Specimens — What was sent to pathology

Anesthesia Records

  • Type of anesthesia used
  • Medications administered
  • Vital signs during procedure
  • Any intraoperative complications

Individual surgical procedure records are documented with dates and operative details.
